item.title: Starmer Faces a Major Test in a Set of UK Elections: What to Know
item.description: Local elections in England, and parliamentary elections in Scotland and Wales, take place on Thursday. The governing Labour Party is expected to do very badly.

item.title: World in Waiting Game Over Iran Peace Proposal Response
item.description: An Iranian official said that Tehran would convey its reply through Pakistan, a key mediator. Another Iranian official earlier dismissed a reported proposal to end the war as a “list of American wishes.”

item.title: The Iran War and Angry Voters
item.description: Economic pain is pushing many Europeans to the nationalist right. Local elections in Britain should give clues about how many.

item.title: In Talks With Iran, China Calls for Opening of Strait of Hormuz
item.description: China’s top diplomat also warned against the restarting of hostilities as he met with Iran’s foreign minister. The U.S. has urged China to pressure Iran to reopen the waterway.

item.title: Iran’s Oil Sector and Economy Are Under Pressure as U.S. Blockade Bites
item.description: Tehran says it can endure the pain, but its oil may soon have nowhere to go.
